analysis.summary: The PR introduces a 'Remember Password' feature but contains a critical module resolution error and a logic flaw where auxiliary storage failures block the primary authentication flow.

bugs.title: Invalid Zod module import path
bugs.description: The code attempts to import 'z' from 'zod/v3'. This is not a valid entry point for the Zod library (which uses 'zod').
bugs.risk: This will cause a module resolution error at build time or a runtime crash when the component is loaded, preventing any users from accessing the login page.

bugs.title: Authentication redirect blocked by storage failures
bugs.description: The onSubmit function awaits saveCredentials and clearCredentials. Because saveCredentials re-throws errors, any failure in the Credential Management API (e.g., non-secure context or browser rejection) will trigger the catch block and prevent the call to redirectToContinue().
bugs.risk: Users may be successfully authenticated on the server but remain stuck on the login page because the auxiliary 'remember password' logic failed. This causes an inconsistent application state and prevents user access.

notBugs.reason: Direct usage of PasswordCredential without checking for the global constructor is ignored per instructions as potential linting issues.

While versions like @hookform/resolvers ^5.2.2 appear to exceed current public releases, they are treated as potentially valid internal or future-proofed configurations rather than functional logic bugs.
The 'Check' icon import is assumed to be part of the existing project setup even if not explicitly added to the package.json diff.
